evidence.V1: Front, three-quarter and silhouette all read as a barrel (stave stripes, two hoop notches in outline, tapered ends); top reads as a staved rim with recessed head. Bulge is mild so the silhouette leans toward a can, but it stays recognisable at 64 px.
evidence.V2: Big body + two medium hoops + recessed head, but the small tier is only colour stripes: no stave grooves, hoop rivets/nails or bung, so the mid-to-small read is thin.
evidence.V3: Chunky hoops and fat staves are stylised, but the body is tall and near-straight with a weak belly bulge; widest point sits near the top hoop rather than mid-height, so it reads partly exaggerated, not confident.
evidence.V4: Hoops carry a small chamfer that catches a highlight on the top edge, and the rim lip is softened, but staves have no edge treatment at all (colour-only boundaries) and the bottom edge rolls in rather than showing a bevel; inconsistent.
evidence.V5: Close-ups (hoop/lid, studio + flat) show no patches, pinches, z-fighting or seams; faceting is the systematic per-stave planking, with only slight polygon kinks in the outline below the top hoop. Symmetry error X/Y 0.0, A17/A18 clean.
evidence.V6: One wood hue in three values (light stave, dark stave, darker head) plus gold accent; walnut and painted teal colourways keep the same disciplined structure.
evidence.V7: 1152 tris vs medium target 2000 / ceiling 4000: well under target.
evidence.V8: One white LF_VertexColor material, gold accent and smooth stylised shading match the Pipe_Run anchor's look; wood hue held to 3 values as the kit allows.
evidence.V9: Studio line correct: Anchored, CollisionFidelity Hull, CanTouch off, CastShadow on, MeshPart.Color white, SmoothPlastic, origin bottom-centre (A12 pass).
